title: DEFER: F4 cond2 framed necessity largely already in #1782
body:
## Disposition: defer / closed

**Not merged.** Master independent review found the headline claim is already witnessed by open [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1782](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1782).

#1782 `CERTIFICATE.json` `f4_target_feed_probe` already records `cond2=false`, `boundary_operator_exact`, `frames_at_cut_equal`, `semantic_K_equals_raw_K`, `d_source_reads=18154`, and the README states F4 preserves scalar operator/endpoint/frames while failing only condition 2. This package’s 661-column framed replay, literal F/R agreement, paid mass 5129, and ADD bill `24305→24374` are useful hygiene but do not establish a non-entailed new independence fact beyond that open probe.

Package head `eba5ebcf` still verifies locally (`PASS_H2SEM_COND2_FRAMED_NECESSITY` / registered), but is not submitted as a freestanding research claim. A useful follow-up would need a non-compositional framed failure mode, a general D-local substitute for condition 2, or a new wrap that changes the paid profile while preserving the dirty endpoint.
